race.comment: ART OF FRANK (1) is stepping out for the first time. By top sire Art Major and hails from the Rickie Alchin stable. Has strong trial form coming into this, winning his latest hitout at this circuit and distance and the inside draw is an aid to a first starter. PEACHESNCREAM (10) cops a wide draw but should find this easier than recent attempts. Building in fitness so is a player with even luck. SWEET PERFECTION (3) draws well and looks close to a win after finishing second in both appearances at Penrith so far, the latest from the back row. GATTUSO (2) came from wider in finishing runner-up at Newcastle last time out so should enjoy the low draw.
